findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_artwork_uploader_link · Private data: get_artwork_requirements, request_artwork_upload, attach_artwork, attach_artwork_from_url, attach_artwork_inline, get_artwork_uploader_link, check_artwork, list_artwork, remove_artwork, prepare_checkout · Public sink: get_quote, create_quote, share_quote, email_quote, send_invite, request_artwork_upload, get_artwork_uploader_link · Destructive: get_artwork_guide, delete_address, remove_cart_line, update_quote, delete_quote, remove_artwork, prepare_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_artwork_uploader_link · Private data: get_artwork_requirements, request_artwork_upload, attach_artwork, attach_artwork_from_url, attach_artwork_inline, get_artwork_uploader_link, check_artwork, list_artwork, remove_artwork, prepare_checkout · Public sink: get_quote, create_quote, share_quote, email_quote, send_invite, request_artwork_upload, get_artwork_uploader_link · Destructive: get_artwork_guide, delete_address, remove_cart_line, update_quote, delete_quote, remove_artwork, prepare_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
